description: Synthetic FHIR-JSON claims-financial feed (batch bundle) forming the golden-thread financial chain: a PAID chain (Claim c-1 -> ClaimResponse cr-1 outcome=complete -> ExplanationOfBenefit eob-1) and a DENIED chain (Claim c-2 -> ClaimResponse cr-2 outcome=error carrying CARC 197 + RARC N130 adjustment codes -> ExplanationOfBenefit eob-2), plus 1 malformed Claim missing the patient subject (quarantine). No member names; subjects are source ids anchored through the identity seam. ClaimResponse.request references the Claim (adjudicated-by) and the EOB carries a synthetic claimResponse reference (explained-by); real payer linkage is deferred to I8A.
